info.name: Module 5 - AI Email Negotiation
info.description:
API endpoints for automated email-based supplier negotiations.

Workflow:
1. Start negotiation with suppliers (sends initial RFQ emails)
2. Check for supplier replies
3. Run negotiation rounds (AI generates counter-offers)
4. Accept, reject, or close negotiations

**Setup:**
- Set the `base_url` variable (default: http://localhost:5000)
- Set `smtp_username` and `smtp_password` for sending emails
- Set `buyer_email` to your sender email address

request.description:
Start negotiations with one or more suppliers.

This will:
1. Create negotiation threads for each supplier
2. Generate personalized RFQ emails using AI
3. Send the emails if `send_emails` is true

**Note:** For Gmail, use an App Password (not your regular password).
Generate one at: https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords

List all negotiation threads.

Optional query params:
- `project_id`: Filter by project
- `status`: Filter by status (draft, initial_sent, pending_reply, negotiating, accepted, rejected, closed)
Get details of a specific negotiation thread including all emails exchanged.

Check inbox for supplier replies and match them to negotiation threads.

The system will:
1. Poll the inbox for emails from tracked suppliers
2. Parse supplier responses using AI to extract offers
3. Update thread state with the new offers

Set `timeout_s` > 0 to wait for new emails (long-polling).

Run a negotiation round for a specific thread.

This will:
1. Evaluate the current supplier offer
2. Compute an AI-powered counter-offer
3. Generate a professional negotiation email
4. Send the email if `send_email` is true

If `auto_accept` is true, the system will automatically accept offers that meet the buyer's criteria.
Manually accept the current offer and send an acceptance email.
Reject and close the negotiation with an optional reason.
Close a negotiation thread without accepting or rejecting.
Get a summary of all negotiations including status breakdown and best offers.
Direct text-based negotiation without email workflow. Useful for testing the AI negotiation logic.
